evidence.salary_frequency: per month (implied by range format and context)
evidence.education_required: Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or related field
evidence.must_have_skills_source: Proficiency in design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, InVision). Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, interaction design, and accessibility standards. Experience working on responsive and mobile-first designs.
evidence.nice_to_have_skills_source: Experience with front-end development (HTML/CSS/JS). Familiarity with design systems and component libraries. Knowledge of motion design or microinteractions. Prior experience in agile/scrum environments.
